capabilities: Annotate PDFs, images, and Markdown views with stylus, mouse, or touch ink
Draw with pen, pencil, highlighter, laser pointer, eraser, and lasso tools from a movable toolbar
Insert, delete, import, and scan PDF pages with atomic sidecar remapping
Export annotated PDFs as flattened or editable copies and images as flattened copies
Create GoodNotes-inspired blank PDF notebooks via commands
disambiguation: Not handwriting recognition or ink-to-text conversion; it only adds freehand ink and text-box annotation to PDFs, images, and Markdown views.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; processing is local-only with no telemetry; PDF.js and pdf-lib runtimes are bundled so BRAT installs need no CDN; the author requests donations.
motivation: The author built it after realizing they use Obsidian far more than another (unnamed) note-taking app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite or ink-annotate PDFs, images, or notes, which pushes users to outside note-taking apps for this.

relations.evidence: PDF.js remains the parser, text, annotation, and raster-rendering engine
Commands to create a GoodNotes-inspired blank PDF notebook

summary: Ink annotation plugin for handwriting locally on PDFs, PNG/JPEG images, and Markdown views with a stylus, mouse, or touch.
